searched.found: llm_client passes provider caching through (automatic shared-prefix detection over 4,096 characters, PromptCachePolicy, cache_breakpoint); prompt-design's caching procedure says order stable text first and measure cache reads. Neither shortens what the judge is given.

OpenAI caches automatically the identical leading part of prompts over 1,024 tokens; Anthropic caches up to a cache_control breakpoint. Both need the varying text after the stable text.
